issues.claim: Sources: "Page sitemap, 14 pages, no Spotswood page, March 2026 page updates"
issues.problem: The page sitemap served today contains 15 <url> entries, not 14: /, testimonials, faqs, schedule-an-appointment, about-us, physical-therapy, other, occupational-therapy, conditions-we-treat, locations, hand-therapy, new-patients, staff, mission-statement, careers-at-first-rehab. The 'no Spotswood page' and 'March 2026 updates' parts are correct.
issues.fix: Change '14 pages' to '15 pages' (or drop the count and say 'no Spotswood location page'). analysis.json contains the same '14-page sitemap' figure and should be corrected too.

issues.claim: Intro: "Its website describes Lakewood only." (repeated in the founder email: 'a site that describes Lakewood only')
issues.problem: Overstated. Visibly, every page body, the footer and the NAP block are Lakewood-only, but the home page title tag reads 'First Rehab: Physical / Occupational Therapy Lakewood & Spotswood, NJ' and its meta description says '...in Spotswood & Lakewood NJ'. The site therefore names Spotswood in metadata while publishing no Spotswood content, which is a distinct and weaker claim than 'describes Lakewood only'.
issues.fix: Say what is verifiable: 'Its website names both towns in its page titles but publishes the Lakewood clinic only - no Spotswood page, address, hours or phone.' Apply the same wording to the email line.

issues.claim: "Spotswood's reviews read years old" and the Google listing has 5.0 from 10 reviews
issues.problem: Confirmed, but the audit does not say that the ten reviews are all that exist and that the two most recent visible ones are ~4 years old with a ~7-year-old one behind them; as written a reader could think only some reviews are old. No error of fact - just under-specified.
issues.fix: Optional: 'all ten visible reviews are four to seven years old'. No factual change required.

issues.problem: The band is correct against the cited review, but the 39% ceiling comes from predictive-model phone-call reminders (median RR 0.61, moderate certainty) - i.e. a human-voice contact rate - while 9% is the text-message figure (median RR 0.91, high certainty). The audit presents the band without that distinction, which can read as if a text/SMS agent reaches 39%.
issues.fix: Add a half-sentence: '9% is the text-reminder effect; 39% assumes phone-call-level contact, the ceiling we would test towards.'

issues.problem: The body (intro through the closing line, headings included, sources and founder section excluded) is ~460 words, marginally over the ~450 target.
issues.fix: Trim ~15 words, e.g. shorten the opening line and the 'What we would build' list in opportunity 1.
